verdict.rationale: Full-text search is a fair question for a backend-as-a-service database, so the axis applies, but the pack never documents a full-text search query or full-text index in Appwrite's databases. Generic typed indexes (appwrite-docs-6) and vector similarity search in VectorsDB (appwrite-docs-72) are adjacent features, not full-text search, so they earn no credit. A dedicated PostgreSQL engine (appwrite-docs-46) is not documented as offering full-text search either.
